stories.s: Tatjana Smith's decision to switch allegiance to the Netherlands is "sad" for South Africa, says the head of the nation's swimming federation.

stories.t: Former Ukrainian foreign minister discusses how to bridge gaps between Ukraine, Russia
stories.s: NPR's A Martinez asks Ukraine's former Foreign Minister Dmytro Kuleba for his proposals to close gaps in talks between Russia, Ukraine and Europe.

stories.t: Former U.S. Ambassador William Taylor discusses the latest Russia-Ukraine talks
stories.s: NPR's A Martinez speaks with former U.S. ambassador to Ukraine, William Taylor, about the ongoing peace talks between the U.S., Russia and Ukraine.

stories.t: U.S. officials set to meet with Putin, Zelenskyy following Abu Dhabi peace talks
stories.s: U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi have wrapped up with an agreement on a Russia-Ukraine prisoner exchange. U.S. negotiators meet with Vladimir Putin on Thursday and Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Friday.

stories.t: Drought threatens Iraq's marshes, risking one of the oldest ways of life
stories.s: The unique marshes of southern Iraq are beginning to revive after five years of devastating drought. But challenges remain for one of the world's oldest ways of life.

stories.t: Aid groups call on Israel to allow shelters in Gaza amid a humanitarian emergency
stories.s: Winter storms have brought flooding and deadly landslides to thousands living in tents in Gaza. Palestinians have no where to go after years of devasting war.

stories.t: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
stories.s: The news comes at a turbulent time for President Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.

stories.t: 'No light, no water, no heat': Ukrainians struggle with blackouts as Russia hits power grid
stories.s: For parents in parts of Ukraine, trying to lead a normal family life with just a few hours of power each day is taking its toll.

stories.t: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning
stories.s: The girls started vomiting after eating oranges brought in by a fellow pupil - police are travelling to the village they came from.

stories.t: Can Nigeria's president regain voters' trust after painful first term?
stories.s: For Nigerians to feel meaningful improvements, reforms will need to go beyond the promises outlined, analysts say.

stories.t: Why did a day off for Finland's embassy in Australia go viral?
stories.s: Sleuths shared their "despair" when Finland's embassy in Australia's capital closed for 24 hours to hold a planning day and expressed "relief" when it reopened.
